decision.observation: The goose stands facing the closed gate on the dirt path; beyond it the path rises over a wooden bridge toward tall grass. No character is visible on either side. The latch pipe on the gate's top rail has resisted every grab/slide variant tried.
decision.hypothesis: In this game a groundskeeper beyond the gate may respond to honking and open the gate. A single early honk produced no visible response, but it may need to be sustained or repeated while the goose faces the gate.
decision.memory: Gate latch hardware grabs (left/Ctrl/right/Z, all directions) never visibly moved the bolt. Honk = Space; this may be a progression gate controlled by a character.
